INSERT INTO user_book_data (user_id, book_id, rating, rating_source, rating_updated_at)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, NOW())
        ON CONFLICT (user_id, book_id) DO UPDATE SET
            rating = $3,
            rating_source = $4,
            rating_updated_at = NOW(),
            updated_at = NOW()
        RETURNING id
